about: The ONLYOFFICE Docs release this app takes its editor files from. scripts/upstream-watch.mjs compares it with the newest one every week; change it only together with the bundle built from it.

x2t.about: The converter, x2t, built to WebAssembly - for now CryptPad's build, pinned by its release's SHA-512 and its two files' SHA-256; scripts/fetch-x2t.mjs fetches and checks it. Before 0.1.0 this project builds its own from ONLYOFFICE core at source_tag and this entry names that build instead.
x2t.from: CryptPad's onlyoffice-x2t-wasm (AGPL-3.0-or-later): ONLYOFFICE core with CryptPad's changes, built with emscripten. Its core/ was pulled from Euro-Office's copy of ONLYOFFICE core at v9.3.2.
